info.syllabusName: Dự án Capstone kinh doanh điện tử (E-Business Capstone Project)
info.description: This capstone course applies concepts from digital business and e-commerce to real-world challenges, drawing on models of platforms, ecosystems, and digital transformation. Students explore emerging technologies and regulatory issues, analyze business models, and design innovative solutions tailored to the Vietnamese and global context. Through case studies, workshops, and a final project, the course emphasizes creativity, sustainability, and adaptability in developing future-ready e-business strategies.
info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU

clos.loDetails: Understand the key concepts, technologies, and strategies that drive digital business and electronic commerce
Analyze and evaluate digital business models and digital transformation strategies
Apply digital tools and frameworks to develop feasible, innovative digital business solutions suitable for real-world challenges in Vietnam
